note: Gregory County has a zoning ordinance (Sections 1411-1425) but no queryable ArcGIS zoning district layer was found. The county GIS viewer (gis.districtiii.org/gregory and the Equator Studios viewer) exposed no REST service URLs for zoning. The City of Gregory publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Gregory_Zoning_Map_2-26-2025.pdf). Regrid's parcel dataset carries zoning fields but is a commercial, non-queryable copy.
